title: Expenditure and service level data for water supply systems and sanitation facilities in Ghana
authors: IRC International Water and Sanitation Centre
contributors: IRC International Water and Sanitation Centre
Funding Agency: IRC International Water and Sanitation Centre

contacts.name: IRC  International Water and Sanitation Centre

descriptions: Expenditure and services level data delivered by a variety of of water supply systems and sanitation facilities in Ghana.Primary data collection of household and water point surveys and secondary data was collected in 31 rural communities and four small towns. Service levels were developed from 1,273 household undertaken. Expenditure data was also gathered from the community water and sanitation centre, specifically contract data on 1,591 boreholes with handpumps and financial records from a further 63 small town system

spatial_coverage: The communities sampled were drawn from 3 districts of Ghana: Bosomtwe, Ketu South and East Gonja

relations.text: This dataset represents part of the data collected and validated in Ghana by the WASHCost team.

data_sources: Infrastructure surveys, specific data from the Community Water and Sanitation Agency, contract data
